title: 'Hell Mode Season 2' Reveals Additional Cast for Rosenheim Arc
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Hamuo 's Hell Mode: Yarikomizuki no Gamer wa Hai Settei no Isekai de Musou suru ( Hell Mode: The Hardcore Gamer Dominates in Another World with Garbage Balancing ) light novel revealed additional cast and new visual (pictured right) for the second season on…
author: MyAnimeList

title: Makoto Shinkai’s Next Anime Film Secures Global Distribution by Crunchyroll, Director Says Theatrical Release Is Probably Not Far Away
content: Crunchyroll has acquired the global distribution rights outside Asia, except for India, to acclaimed director Makoto Shinkai’s next feature film. Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment will co-distribute the upcoming anime film internationally. The announcement was made on August 12.
author: Anime Corner

title: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life Anime Reveals Action Trailer
content: The Laid-Off Cheat-Granting Mage Enjoys a Second Lease on Life has revealed a new action trailer ahead of the anime’s October 2026 premiere. The anime was announced in February.
author: Anime Corner

title: Inherit the Winds TV Anime Casts Takeo Ōtsuka
content: The official X/Twitter account for the original television anime project Inherit the Winds ( Kaze wo Tsugumono ) announced on Wednesday that Takeo Ōtsuka will play Yamanaka Keisuke ( historical Japanese characters' names are rendered family name first here ): The anime takes place in the Bakumatsu era in Kyoto.
author: ANN

title: Live-Action Can You Kiss Me First? Series Unveils More Cast
content: The official website for the live-action series of Yamayade 's Can You Kiss Me First? ( Omae no Hou kara Kiss Shitekure yo ) boys' love manga unveiled a new visual and cast members for the series on Wednesday.
author: ANN

title: Vermeil in Gold Manga Artist Yōko Umezu Dies
content: The editors for Square Enix 's Monthly Shonen Gangan magazine announced on Wednesday that manga artist Yōko Umezu had died on July 7 due to cerebral infarction (ischemic stroke). The magazine's editors stated that a private funeral was held, attended only by close relatives.
author: ANN

title: 'Tank Chair' Reveals Additional Cast, Staff, Theme Songs, First Promo
content: The official website for the television anime adaptation of Manabu Yashiro 's Tank Chair manga revealed additional cast, staff, a key visual (pictured), the theme songs, and first promotional video on Wednesday. The anime series is scheduled to premiere on October 4 at 11:00 p.m.
author: MyAnimeList

title: Tank Chair Anime's New Video Unveils More Cast & Staff, Song Artists, October 4 Debut
content: Bandai Namco Filmworks presented the main promotional video, key visual, additional cast and staff members, theme song artists, and October 4 premiere for the television anime of Manabu Yashiro 's Tank Chair manga on Wednesday. The video announces and previews the opening theme song "DALALA" by reggae-punk band SiM .
author: ANN

title: Crunchyroll to Release Makoto Shinkai's New Film Globally, Excluding Most of Asia
content: Crunchyroll did not reveal details about Shinkai's new film, including its title. Shinkai stated on social media in November 2025 he has been working on a "new film" alongside "dependable companions," adding that he could not yet formally announce the work.
author: ANN

title: Riddle Kamimura Ends Mikiri Kara Hajimeru Garyū Kenjutsu Manga
content: The fantasy story centers on Rio, who lives in a border town. To protect himself, he signs up for swordsmanship lessons in the town's training grounds, but quickly loses hope in the tutelage there.
author: ANN
